resources.string: Saved files stay here until you delete them. Export to keep a copy outside the app.
View a status in WhatsApp first, then connect its Media/.Statuses folder. You can also connect WhatsApp Business.
Save a status, import an image or video, or download a public media link.
Enable “Show hidden files” in the folder picker and choose .Statuses, or choose its Media parent. If Android hides this location, share or import the media file instead.
This deletes the app\'s saved copy. Your original status or imported file stays in its source folder.
Paste a direct image/video link or a public page that exposes a video file. You can also share a link to Status Saver from another app.
Download queued or running. You can find it in Saved when it finishes.
Import images and videos from your phone, or share them directly to Status Saver.
Availability depends on what each public page exposes. Private stories, sign-in pages, and pages protected against automated access cannot be downloaded here.
Save, organize, and share images and videos with a modern Android interface.
Open a status in WhatsApp, connect the .Statuses folder, and use Save from a media card. Use the Saved tab to preview, share, export, or delete your copies.
Saved copies live in this app\'s storage. Export important files before uninstalling the app. Import can bring older downloads into your collection.
No account, advertising SDK, analytics, or clipboard monitoring. The app reads folders you select and contacts a link\'s server only when you choose Download.
Android\'s folder picker grants access to selected folders. No broad storage permission is required. Disconnect folders to remove that access.
